constraints.message: Your army must include at least {difference} more Psyker units

publications.name: The Long War - Codex Craftworld Eldar

rules.name: Militia Ranks
rules.description: An Ulthwe army must include at least 2 Militia units per 1000pts unless restricted by a Rite of War.

rules.name: Preferred Hosts
rules.description: If your army is using a Rite of War other than the Wind Rider Host, you do not gain the first listed Benefit of the Rite of War.

rules.name: Despondent Outcasts
rules.description: Your army must include at least 1 Outcast unit per 1000pts unless restricted by a Rite of War.

rules.name: Preferred Hosts
rules.description: If your army is using a Rite of War other than the Shrine Host, you do not gain the first listed Benefit of the Rite of War.

rules.name: Preferred Hosts
rules.description: If your army is using a Rite of War other than the Wraith Host, you do not gain the first listed Benefit of the Rite of War.

rules.name: Home of Lost Aspects
rules.description: Your army must include at least 1 unit of Shadow Specters per 1000pts.

rules.name: Consummate Commander
rules.description: While this unit is either on the battlefield, in reserves or embarked in a transport, you may re-roll rolls when determining if a unit will arrive via Outflank or Deep Strike.

rules.name: Walker of Many Paths
rules.description:
When mustering your army, the Autarch must select 3 of the following Aspects:
• Aspect of Dire Avenger: The unit gains the Last Stand special rule.
• Aspect of the Howling Banshee: The unit gains the Fleet special rule.
• Aspect of the Striking Scorpion: The unit gains the Infiltrate special rule.
• Aspect of the Dark Reaper: The unit gains the Relentless special rule.
• Aspect of the Swooping Hawk: The unit gains the Sprint (2) special rule.
• Aspect of the Warp Spider: The unit gains the Hit & Run special rule.
• Aspect of the Crimson Hunter: The unit gains the Precision Hits special rule on all weapons they are equipped with.
• Aspect of the Fire Dragon: The unit gains the gains the Tank Hunter special rule.
• Aspect of the Shining Spear: The unit gains the Skilled Rider special rule.
• Aspect of the Shadow Specter: The unit gains the Skirmisher special rule.

sharedRules.name: Phoenix Lord
sharedRules.description: You may include 1 unit in your army with this special rule.

sharedRules.name: Battle Focus
sharedRules.description: Units with this special rule are treated as having performed a Normal Move in the Movement Phase even if they Advanced in the Movement Phase for the purposes of Shooting.

sharedRules.name: Seer Council
sharedRules.description: During Deployment, a unit with this special rule may be fielded as 1 unit or instead may be broken up. If the unit is fielded as 1 unit, it loses the Character special rule. If the unit is broken up, all models in the unit are now treated as individual units with the Character special rule for the rest of the battle.

sharedRules.name: Monofilament
sharedRules.description: When rolling to wound or penetrate against a target with this weapon, instead of using the targets Toughness (T) characteristic roll to wound by comparing the targets Initiative (I) characteristic to the weapons Strength (S) characteristic on the wound chart. Monofilament weapons are resolved against the AV of Vehicles, Fortifications, Titans, Knights and Aircraft type units as normal. For Instant Death, the weapon is Instant Death if its Strength (S) characteristic is double the targets Initiative (I) characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Wild Host
sharedRules.description: Saim-Hann units gain the Furious Charge special rule.

sharedRules.name: Rigid Path Walkers
sharedRules.description: Alaitoc units in your army gain the Zealot special rule.

sharedRules.name: The Swordwind
sharedRules.description: Biel-Tan units gain the Hit & Run special rule.

sharedRules.name: Stoic Endurance
sharedRules.description: Iyanden units gain the Stubborn special rule.

sharedRules.name: Masterful Stealth
sharedRules.description: During the first Battle Round, all friendly Mymeara units gain the benefit of Heavy Cover. In addition, all Mymeara Aircraft units always gain the benefit of Light Cover, even if they would normally not.

sharedRules.name: Foresight of the Damned
sharedRules.description: After deployment is complete but before the first turn begins, you may select 1 Ulthwe unit in your army per 500pts to re-deploy as if it were the Deployment Step.

rules.name: Shroud Runner Jetbike
rules.description: A model that is equipped with Shroud Runner Jetbike becomes the Jetbike type. The Shroud Runner Jetbike increases the models Toughness (T) by 1 and Wounds (W) characteristic by 1. The Shroud Runner Jetbike is equipped with Scatter Laser.

rules.name: Mandiblasters
rules.description: A model equipped with this Wargear gains +1 to its Attacks (A) Characteristics.

rules.name: Scatter Shield
rules.description: This wargear confers a 4+ Invulnerable save and all charges against this unit are considered Disordered.

rules.name: Gloom Field
rules.description: A unit that includes a model with this wargear always receives the benefit of Light Cover, If the unit is already benefiting from Light Cover, it gains the benefit of Heavy Cover instead.

rules.name: Howling Banshee Mask
rules.description: A unit which includes a model equipped with this wargear reduces the Initiative (I) of enemy units within 3” by 1.

rules.name: Shimmer Shield
rules.description: This wargear confers a 4+ Invulnerable save to the equipped model and their entire unit.

rules.name: Camo Cloak
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear always receives the benefit of Light Cover. A model with this wargear already receiving the benefit of Light Cover, gains the benefit of Heavy Cover instead. If a model is already benefiting from Heavy Cover, it gains a 4+ Cover save.

rules.name: Melta Bomb
rules.description: In combat, a model with this wargear may forgo its attacks and instead make a single Strength 8, AP1 attack with the Melta Special rule at Initiative step 1.

rules.name: Aspect Armour
rules.description: A high protection but high mobility suit. Confers a 4+ armour save.

rules.name: Heavy Aspect Armour
rules.description: Heavy high protection but high mobility suit. Confers a 3+ armour save.

rules.name: Phoenix Armour
rules.description: An artifice suit of unique armour. Confers a 2+ armour save.

rules.name: Mesh Armour
rules.description: Tightfitting Mesh and plate armour. This confers a 5+ save.

rules.name: Rune Armour
rules.description: Light Armour fitted with protective runes. This confers a 4+ Invulnerable save and a 5+ Armour save.

rules.name: Wraithbone plate
rules.description: A living heavy organic armour plate. Confers a 2+ armour save.

rules.name: Light Weight Plating
rules.description: Light Weight plating used in many Eldar vehicles. It confers a 3+ Armour save.

rules.name: Swooping Hawk Wings
rules.description: A model that is equipped with Wings increases its Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. The equipped unit gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep Strike special rules.

rules.name: Jump Pack
rules.description: A model that is equipped with Wings increases its Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. The equipped unit gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep Strike special rules.

rules.name: Blink Pack
rules.description:
A model equipped with a Blink Pack increase their Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. In addition, the model gains the Deep Strike & Fly special rules. A unit entirely equipped with this wargear may Set to Blink
instead of Overwatch in the Shooting Phase. If there are no enemy units within 3” of the unit that Set to Blink at the end your opponent’s Charge Phase, you may remove the unit from the board and place it back into ongoing reserves. The unit that is returns to reserves this way is not considered slain if it is not on the board by battle round 4.

rules.name: Star Engines
rules.description: Increase a model with this wargear’s Movement (M) characteristic by 2”

rules.name: Jetbike
rules.description: A model that is equipped with Jetbike becomes the Jetbike type. The Jetbike increases the models Toughness (T) by 1. The Jetbike is equipped with Linked Shuriken Catapults.

rules.name: Spirit Stones
rules.description: When a model with this special rule suffers a Crew Injury result on the Vehicle Damage Table, it is instead treated as a Superficial Damage result.

rules.name: Vectored Engines
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains the Deep Strike special rule.

rules.name: Wire Weave Net
rules.description: A unit that contains a model equipped with this wargear always counts any charges made against it as Disordered.

rules.name: Ambush of Blades
rules.description: Once per game, the warlord and any attached unit gains the Rending (5+) special rule on all weapons they are equipped with.

rules.name: Falcon’s Swiftness
rules.description: The Warlord gains the Sudden Strike special rule and increases their Movement (M) characteristic by 2”.

rules.name: Fates Messenger
rules.description: The Warlord gains the Feel no Pain (5+) and Regeneration special rules.

rules.name: Faolchú’s Wing
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains +12” to their Movement (M) characteristic.

rules.name: The Spirit Stone of Anath’lan
rules.description: model equipped with this Relic can roll 3 dice when making a Psychic test and discard the highest result before determining of the Psychic test is passed.

rules.name: The Phoenix Gem
rules.description: The first time a model with this wargear would be slain and removed from play, they are not. The model remains on the battlefield and removes all wounds allocated to it. All enemy units within 6” of the equipped model take 2D6 Strength 5, AP5 automatic hits when the bearer of the Relic is Slain.

rules.name: Guide
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single friendly unit within 24” of the Psyker. That unit may re-roll all to hit rolls until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Doom
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single enemy unit within 24” of the Psyker. All friendly Eldar units may re-roll to wound rolls and penetration rolls against that target until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Fortune
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single friendly unit within 24” of the Psyker. That unit gains the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Eldritch Storm
rules.description:
When this Power is Cast, select one of the following effects:
1. Place a Storm Token within 18” of the Caster.
2. Move a Storm Token on the battlefield 2D6”


At the end of the Casters Shooting Phase, or at the end of opponents Movement Phase, all enemy units within 5” of the Storm Token take D6, Strength 6, AP4 Automatic Hits. Wounds and Saves are made as normal. Only 1 Storm Token can be placed on the battlefield. If the Caster attempts to place a new Storm Token using this Psychic Power, the previous token is removed and no longer in effect.

rules.name: Mind War
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single enemy model within 24” of the Psyker. The target model must make a Leadership test. On a pass, the target model takes 1 Automatic Wound with no saves allowed. If the target failed, they take D3+1 Automatic Wounds instead with no saves allowed.

rules.name: Empower
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Enervate
rules.description: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 12” of the Psyker. The target suffers -1 to their Strength (S) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Embolden
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit automatically pass Pinning and Panic tests until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Horrify
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Fear (3) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Conceal
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the benefit of Heavy Cover until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Reveal
rules.description: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 24” of the Psyker. The target unit cannot claim Cover Saves until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Enhance
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Drain
rules.description: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 12” of the Psyker. The target suffers -1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.
